Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

TAPER MALE STUD ELBOW BODY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 

PART I MADE FROM FORCINGS

1. Scope— Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud elbow 
body made from forgings for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3« Material— Steel according to Class 1A of IS ; 1875-1978 'Specification for carbon steel billets, 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings {fourth revision ) ' or any other steel as agreed to be^een the 
user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Elbow bodie^ are to be phosphated according to Class A2 of 
IS ; 3618-1966 * Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against 
corrosion ' unless otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These elbow bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type A of IS : 9411-1980 

* Specification for elbow coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems \ 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS ; 8805 ( Part 1 )-1978 

* General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems; Part I General *. 

6. Designation— A taper male stud elbow body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 6 mm 
and conforming to this standard shall be- designated as; 

Stud Elbow Body L6 IS ; 9387 ( Part I ) 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers elbow bodies made from forgings only. The elbow bodies made from 
bar stock are covered in IS : 9387 ( Part II )-1979 * Specification for taper male stud elbow body for 
oil-hydraulic couplings; Part II Made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the 
following standards; 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes; 
Part 1 Heavy series ( metric ), and Part 3 Light series ( metric ). 

DIN 3903 Non soldered taper bush type pipe unions ; elbow used as an adaptor with taper 
thread on screwed in end for use with union nut. 



Adopted 19 December 1979
